notes.title: New Hotfix to My Cozy Room!
notes.content: [h2]Dear Cozy Designers![/h2][p][/p][h3]Thank you for your extremely helpful feedback! Listening to your requests, we have prepared for you a Hotfix 1.1 to My Cozy Room! 📢📢📢[/h3][p][/p][p]What exactly will you find in the update? Firstly, to maximize your design experience, we have made [b]improvements in cursor functionality🖱️[/b].[/p][p]We also [b]tweaked the lighting[/b], and for those who appreciate playing by their own rules, quietly 😌, we set the [b]default ambient volume to 0 🔇[/b], and [b]lowered the volume of SFX 🔉[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/fb93a7326e2fab6ae6282439d8a8d668f2f9485f.png"][/img][/p][p]We're constantly taking in your feedback and working behind the scenes to implement as much as possible as quickly as possible. Thank you for your continued support! 🌞💞[/p][p][b]We hope you will enjoy playing My Cozy Room even more now![/b] 🛋️💖🧸[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: My Cozy Room opens its door for new interior designers today!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there Cozy Designers!🪴[/h2][h2][/h2][p]We would like to thank you for your support and announce that My Cozy Room – a lovely interior design and decorating simulator is available now on Steam. 🎸Rock inspired kitchen, 🎃Halloween bathroom or maybe just the craziest bedroom you can create?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/0a59a2507309c40ea2a395ddac3ef3693ef633d9.png"][/img][/p][p]Pick from a dozen room shapes and let your creativity run loose! Decide what kind of space you want it to be – An artist's cave? Indoor beach heaven? Or maybe just an ordinary, but really cozy bedroom? Match your vision with one of 30+ wallpaper and floor combos to complete your design. 🌈🌞
[/p][p]Now it’s time to go absolutely wild! With over 500 🪑 furniture and decor items across multiple themed sets, you can build the room of your dreams… or nightmares. It’s all up to you, we’re not here to judge. Go full 💘 Valentine’s Day, 🦇 spooky Halloween, 🎍 minimalist zen – or mix them all together into one beautiful chaos! 🏠🔥[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/263284c4ac12061683e09d16c4110849dc725584.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog 3 – Capture the Vibes – Using Photomode & Lighting for the Perfect Shot
notes.content:
[h2]Hi hello cozy decorators!
[/h2]
My Cozy Room gives you all the tools you need to not only design the perfect space, but also capture it beautifully. With Photomode, you can take clean, UI-free screenshots to show off every detail of your creation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/7ff992947ab43691fb5efd2abfac056821964ab8.png[/img]

You can also switch the time of day with a single click! What will enhance the atmosphere of your room more? Will it perhaps be the morning light, golden sunsets, or a calm night glow? The choice is all yours!

Combined with camera controls that let you hold your angles, smooth zoom, and ambient music options, you have full creative freedom to set the mood exactly the way you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/e2253f70ce3a52a6daab150206827f9e8b501134.jpg[/img]

So go ahead – style your dream room, frame the perfect shot, and share your cozy masterpiece with the world!

notes.title: Devlog 2 – Classic chic or rockin' feistiness? – Here are all the styles of My C
notes.content:
[h2]Hello interior stylists!
[/h2]

When we set out to build My Cozy Room, we didn’t just want to give you lots of furniture –we wanted to give you moods. Vibes. Atmospheres. Spaces that feel like you. That’s why we created a wide variety of themed items, wallpapers, and floors that let you decorate not just a room, but a whole aesthetic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/c7e9464d9fe4bbe282ad2636108e380c4dcc5333.png[/img]

In the new full version of the game, all style packs are included from the start – so you can explore, combine, and reinvent your cozy space however you like.
In My Cozy Room, the fun of mixing and matching themes never ends! Combine bold rock decor with sweet Valentine’s Day wallpapers, and sprinkle in a few holiday touches for a truly unique space. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/b26e1989e2439584402c979e4db56b2caf71f25a.png[/img]

With over a dozen themed sets to explore – including art, cats, dogs, Easter, Halloween, summer, rustic cottagecore, and Mediterranean vibes – you’ll have no shortage of inspiration. Each set includes 20 furniture and decorative items, plus at least 2 themed wallpapers and 1 floor pattern to help bring your vision to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/1afe66c5f7402ed53c28285b5d91c5d56704e443.png[/img]

Combine Mediterranean tiles with Rock decor. Add a Halloween wallpaper to your cozy Cottagecore bedroom. It’s your room – make it weird, elegant, joyful, or chaotic. We love it!

notes.title: Devlog 1 – The coziest design simulator – Introducing the world of My Cozy Room
notes.content:
[h2]Lovers of cozy design!
[/h2]

Soon you will have a chance to become a one-of-a-kind interior designer! To make the wait a little more pleasant, we invite you to take a short but very charming tour of the world of My Cozy Room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/6a04fd025d94aabd55439478b33c668d02025976.png[/img]

In creating My Cozy Room we were guided by a few principles. Above all, interior design was to be a relaxing experience, allowing you to let your imagination run wild and create rooms pulled straight out of your most daring design dreams. 

You'll have 11 room shapes and sizes to arrange, more than 30 floor and wall designs to pick and choose from, and a library of over 500 pieces of furniture and decor, in a wide variety of styles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/4961b83bc98433f146e62f2ee29411b4d3eb3d14.gif[/img]

With such a resourceful collection, everyone will find something for themselves! Do you prefer a more romantic style, or maybe boho? Maybe you prefer a more eclectic approach, or perhaps you are just beginning to experiment with style?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/7b29d9a0a9620cead390290132ab417953d88e8d.png[/img]

Take your time, feel the artistic freedom and awaken the true interior design virtuoso in you! 🥰

notes.title: Decorate “Your” Cozy Room at June’s Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello fellow Decorators,[/h2]

Are you ready to take the challenge and unleash your inner artist? 

🏠 In My Cozy Room demo, you'll get access to 10 items from each furnishing and style category — enough to start decorating your dream space!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/9efddfb8344913f1d7d4b4ce1f403f030d5d5268.png[/img]

But in the full version, things get even cozier:

🛋️500+ furniture & decor items
🖼️ 30+ personalized wallpapers and floor styles
🔓 11 uniquely-shaped rooms in all kinds of sizes for maximum creative freedom! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/8d5c8aaa818ab7ab0b7ab2b3a4e20b5b5a0fae1e.gif[/img]

🎨 Whether you're a minimalist or a maximalist, there's plenty of room to express your style. 

We hope you have a blast with the demo and can’t wait to share the full experience with you soon!

notes.title: My Cozy Room Demo is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Decorators,

Are you ready to decorate YOUR way? 
My Cozy Room Demo is now live, and we encourage you to give it a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/11c8768a46bb667dfc81e0acbece59a7bd821eb1.png[/img]

notes.title: Player Survey for My Cozy Room is here!
notes.content:
My Cozy Room is coming to Steam, and we want your input! 

A player feedback survey is now live to help shape the game and bring even more creative freedom. The Steam version of the game will come ready with a big update that adds better photo options, freer camera movement, and the ability to change furniture colors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/6d42deb68f5fc37fe42b77974bfaf63574480495.jpg[/img]

With the new version in the works, now’s the perfect time to share your thoughts! Got ideas or feedback? Fill out the survey and let us know! You can access it via the QR code above or by clicking [url=https://forms.gle/zuJg9sYDoqTGkMvLA]HERE[/url].
